messages.subject: Diamond floor saw
messages.body:
Hi,

I'm looking to rent a diamond floor saw, do you have one available at Kempele? I've rented from you a few times before, account under Teemu Alatalo.

Thanks
Teemu

messages.subject: Re: Diamond floor saw
messages.body:
Hi Teemu,

Thanks for your message. We do have a diamond floor saw at the Kempele depot. Could you let me know which dates you're thinking of so I can check the booking calendar?

Best regards,
Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager

messages.subject: Re: Diamond floor saw
messages.body:
One more thing while I have you - I need to bring back the 140L concrete mixer I've had out. When can I drop it off at Kempele?

Teemu
